tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
böleg: böleg — a group, a body, a band of people [叢]
irgen: irgen — people, the common folk of a camp or realm [百姓]
ögdegsen: ög- — to give; passive -de- plus past participle -gsen, 'having been given' [與了的]
γažar-a: γažar — earth, ground, country; here dative-locative, 'over the land' [地行]
töregsen: töre- — to be born; past participle -gsen, 'born, the one born' [生了的]
burqan-qaldun: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols [山名]
nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的]
neġüžü: neġü- — to move camp, to migrate; converb, 'moving camp' [起着]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
duwa-soqor: Duwa-Soqor — Duwa the One-eyed (soqor 'blind, one-eyed') [兒名]
in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
dobün-mergen: Dobun-Mergen — Dobun the Marksman; spelled Dobün here, the same name [人名]
γarba: γar- — to go out, to go up; past -ba, 'went up' [上去了]
ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
čima-da: či — thou; dative-locative čima-da, 'to thee, for thee' [你行]
bijü: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' [有]
orožu: oro- — to enter, to come in; converb [入着]
ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾]
